_comment: Node perf-smoke (perf job in the node gate): times package.json main import with a budget. The gate's perf-smoke job runs this file when present.
name: perf-smoke-node
description: Node perf-smoke: times the package main entry import (tests/perf-smoke.mjs), budget-checked. Wired into the node gate's perf-smoke job.
